question: The Hugli industrial region is located in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Hugli Industrial Region** is located in the state of **West Bengal**.
 
• This region is one of the most important industrial areas in India, known for its strategic location along the **Hugli River**.
